actual: BUG-1089 changes two one-shot daily_basic operator scripts with no resident process, port, DDL, or activation requirement. Runtime classification treats otherwise-unlisted scripts as unknown, so an explicit none contract is rejected and finish is blocked. Add an extensible, fail-closed operator-script non-runtime classification contract and regression coverage reproducing the BUG-1089 finish scenario without weakening unknown-file safety.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.

expected: The runtime catalog must support explicit exact paths for one-shot non-runtime operator scripts. BUG-1089 finish must accept its two catalogued daily_basic scripts as runtime_impact=none, while unlisted, nonexistent, non-canonical, symbolic-link, wildcard, non-operator-namespace, and runtime-target-overlapping declarations remain fail-closed.
non_goals: Do not start, stop, or restart any user backend without explicit per-target approval.
